description.value: Wakepilot is a watersports rental and charter company operating from three locations on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake — with over 20 years serving the South Okanagan. They offer Sea-Doo, pontoon, deck boat, SUP, kayak, and e-foil rentals as well as fully guided wakeboard and surf charters aboard Supra SA wake boats. A cycling tourist passing through Osoyoos could use Wakepilot for a half-day water activity before continuing on the route.

address.value: NK'MIP Resort, 8000 45 St, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V6, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Wakepilot is a watersports rental and charter operation based on Osoyoos Lake, BC — not an accommodation provider. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
